rate_limits: Global limit: 100 operations/sec in live mode and 25 operations/sec in sandbox; endpoints normally have a 25 operations/sec default, with documented exceptions.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Auditor correct. Official docs (https://docs.stripe.com/rate-limits) state global limits of 100 req/s live and 25 req/s sandbox, plus a default 25 req/s per endpoint (with exceptions). Original wrongly split ~100 read and ~100 write and claimed test mode is higher.
